Top candidates: Green_stem_disorder (green stems/pods persisting at maturity), Anthracnose (stem/pod lesions), White_Mold (stem/pod rot).

Let me view one reference per candidate class.
Green_stem_disorder shows green stems with dried pods - the test image has both green pods AND green stems. Let me check Anthracnose and White_Mold.
Anthracnose reference shows dark brown stems with black fruiting bodies - doesn't match the test image well. Let me check White_Mold (pod/stem).

This Green_stem_disorder pod reference shows green stems with dried pods - a close match. The test image shows:
- Distinctly green, moist stems persisting
- Green pods still present
- Surrounding brown/dried leaf material (senescence of other plant material)
- The plant is clearly still green when it should be maturing

This is consistent with Green_stem_disorder: stems and pods remain green while surrounding plant tissue has dried. The stems are notably green and moist against dried/senesced background material.
